# Constants of Euler derivations on algebras generated by p-torsion units

Let a commutative algebra over a field of characteristic `p > 1` be generated
by finitely many elements `x i` with `(x i)^p = 1`. Suppose it has derivations
`D i` with `D i (x j) = δᵢⱼ x j`. The common kernel of these derivations
consists of ground-field scalars.

For each `i`, the linear operator `1 - (D i)^(p-1)` fixes elements killed by
`D i`. On a monomial it kills the monomial if the exponent of `x i` is
nonzero modulo `p`, and fixes it otherwise. The ordered composite of these
operators therefore fixes elements in the common kernel, and each monomial
in its image is a scalar. Polynomial generation gives the conclusion.

This internal algebra lemma supplies the constants computation for invariant
derivations on the coordinate ring of a first Frobenius kernel whose tangent
matrices are diagonal.
